prompt:
Hyper-realistic nighttime public transit portrait, vertical 3:4 format, casual direct-flash smartphone photo. A young adult East Asian woman sits centered on vintage red-and-black plaid seats, photographed from the front at a slightly high angle with a natural 28–35mm phone-lens perspective. Full body visible from head to boots, realistic proportions and anatomy. She has a naturally curvy adult hourglass figure with a defined waist, wide hips, and full thighs, realistically compressed and shaped by the seated crossed-leg pose. One thigh crosses prominently through the foreground, creating strong natural depth.

Short tousled black bob hair with wispy bangs, softly oval face, dark brown eyes, calm and slightly tired expression, pink lips, minimal makeup, realistic pores and natural flash highlights. She wears a fitted white ribbed camisole with a neckline and black straps, a dark charcoal-gray oversized jacket slipped off both shoulders, narrow white shorts edges, and a delicate gold pendant necklace.

Leaning lazily against the seatback, pelvis slightly forward, upper body subtly tilted. Left arm raised above her head holding a realistic red beverage can, bracelet and rings visible. Right arm relaxed across the adjacent armrest. Natural seated posture with anatomically correct legs and joints.

Vintage distressed dark-brown knee-high leather boots with straps, square buckles, metal rings, eyelets and thick dark soles. Black leather handbag resting on the empty seat beside her. Large black nighttime window behind her with dust, water marks, subtle reflections of passengers and a visible camera-flash reflection. Yellow handrails, gray seat frames and dim carriage interior.

Direct frontal smartphone flash combined with dim transit ceiling lights. Bright realistic highlights on the face, shoulders, camisole and foreground thigh, darker jacket and background, saturated plaid seats. Authentic early-2000s digital camera aesthetic, slight high-ISO grain, mild hard flash shadows, localized sharpening, limited dynamic range, realistic skin texture, no studio lighting, no cinematic color grading, no fisheye distortion, no excessive background blur.
